description.fun: Latias's glass-like down feathers bend light, letting it turn invisible or change how it looks, and in the movies and manga it even disguises itself as a human girl. It's gentle and very clever, understands human speech and talks by telepathy. It keeps its distance from people and other Pokémon and vanishes when an enemy comes near. Every Latias is female; its counterpart, Latios, is always male.
description.guide: A Dragon- and Psychic-type Legendary Pokémon shaped like a jet, always female, and one of the eon duo with Latios. It lives in groups near water and communicates by telepathy. It can Mega Evolve with the Latiasite.
description.tagline: A gentle eon dragon that turns invisible by bending light

description.fun: Mega Latias turns purple, grows horns along its jaw and swaps the wings on its back for larger ones on its arms, looking all but identical to Mega Latios. It can fly at Mach 4, and because it's smaller than Mega Latios it's more agile, able to make very sharp turns. It scatters see-through particles to confuse its foes.
